has authority level

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasAuthorityLevel
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasAuthorityLevel
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The authority grade an issuing system claims for this norm. NOT functional: in a multi-source merge, sources may grade the same norm differently, and those claims coexist rather than collapse (Principle 9 — the kernel-axis convention).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Norm -> gmeow:AuthorityLevel

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasAuthorityLevel from gmeow:Norm to gmeow:AuthorityLevel when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Norm, gmeow:AuthorityLevel

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to record the authority grade an issuing system claims for a norm, referencing the ordered gmeow:AuthorityLevel vocabulary.

Avoid when

  • Avoid forcing a single grade in a merge — sources may grade the same norm differently and those claims coexist, so keep it non-functional — and avoid reading it as the precedence outcome (that is solver work over gmeow:overrides).

How to use

  • Point gmeow:hasAuthorityLevel at a gmeow:AuthorityLevel individual; the solver compares levels via gmeow:strongerThan when resolving conflicts.

Examples

  • ex:n1 gmeow:hasAuthorityLevel gmeow:authorityAbsolute.
